description: This script generates C++ header and implementation files for ANGLE enums based on JSON data. It defines data structures, loads enum data from JSON files, and writes C++ code for enum classes and conversion functions.

methods.name: load_enums
methods.description: Loads enum definitions from a JSON file and returns a sorted list of Enum objects.

methods.name: generate_include_guard
methods.description: Creates an include guard macro name from a file path.

methods.name: header_name_from_cpp_name
methods.description: Converts a C++ source filename to a header filename.

methods.name: write_header
methods.description: Generates and writes a C++ header file defining enum classes based on provided enum data.

methods.name: write_cpp
methods.description: Generates and writes a C++ source file implementing enum conversion functions.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main script entry point handling command-line arguments and orchestrating code generation.
